authority: SCHEV Domicile Guidelines, Code of Virginia 23.1-510(D)

agencies.name: State Council of Higher Education for Virginia

volatility.note: SCHEV's statewide uniform criteria under Code of Virginia 23.1-510(D). The domicile provisions modelled in this pack were re-verified against the primary source on 2026-07-24.

gates.headline: F-1 status blocks domicile in Virginia
gates.explain: Holders of student or temporary visas do not have the capacity to establish domicile in Virginia.

status_classification.note: Part II Section 03(A) directs the institution to determine first whether the student is a national or an alien, and holders of student or temporary visas cannot establish domicile — the rule this pack's gate encodes. The list below is an IMPLEMENTATION BOUNDARY, not a legal category: it names the immigration statuses PathWise has actually read this source against — the three the gate names, plus citizen and lawful permanent resident, for which PathWise returns the durational analysis. PathWise does not claim the source enumerates these five, and this list must not be read as the set of statuses Virginia permits. A status outside it has not been read against the source, so PathWise answers for it neither way: not barred, not permitted.

clock.anchor_definition: First official day of class of the term.
clock.start_rule_note: The clock does NOT start on arrival; look at the date on which the LAST of the qualifying factors occurred.

auxiliary_acts_warning.note: Acts auxiliary to educational objectives, or routinely performed by temporary residents, carry little weight.

construction_rules.note: A prior determination by one institution is not binding on another.
No student shall be denied in-state tuition solely because of a parent's legal status.
